title: avena rupestris
intro: Avena rupestris, commonly known as Rocky Mountain oat grass, is a type of perennial grass that is native to the mountainous regions of North America. This plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and promoting relaxation due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Avena rupestris include acting as a nervine tonic, sedative, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a popular choice for herbal remedies. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
